a.lede: Precautionary takedowns come as experts say bad actors could exploit vulnerability in language used by 70% of sites Websites around the globe have gone dark after a serious vulnerability was found in a computer language used to build much of the world wide web. Belgian, Dutch, Finnish, French and German sites were among those that governments took down temporarily as
a.title: Flaw in PHP computer language leads to shutdown of websites around world

b.lede: All websites using PHP should update to the latest security patch.
b.title: Government websites in the EU and Canada taken offline over PHP vulnerability
